record.one_liner: Telegram provides open APIs (Bot API, MTProto API, Gateway API, and TDLib) allowing developers to build custom messaging clients, bots, mini apps, and verification tools free of charge.

auth_methods.quote: You will get basic addresses as well as the api_id and api_hash parameters required for user authorization.

access_test.quote: We welcome all developers to use our API and source code to create Telegram-like messaging applications on our platform free of charge.

access_ship.quote: It is necessary that you obtain your own API id before you publish your app.

api_breadth.quote: TDLib supports all Telegram features and makes developing Telegram apps a breeze on any platform.
